data.title: 红月卡莲 · 红莲驾驶舱的战后解扣微汗
data.description: 战斗落幕后的红莲圣天八极式驾驶舱内，微弱的仪表灯光流转。卡莲斜倚在全景驾驶椅上，解开紧身驾驶服胸前的气密拉链，露出吸汗内衬与急促起伏的雪白锁骨。薄汗浸透了她红色的发丝，王牌机师长长舒了一口气，转眸看向通讯屏，眼神中透着刚毅之后的信任与战友间的私密默契。
data.location: high-tech mecha cockpit interior with glowing instrument panels
data.action: resting back in pilot seat, pilot suit unzipped at chest, perspiration on collarbone, red spiky hair damp, intense relieved gaze at camera
data.lighting: glowing crimson and cyan cockpit holograms casting dynamic colored rim light
data.mood: exhilarating post-battle adrenaline, fierce intimate bond
data.promptProse: Reclining in the glowing cockpit of the Guren after an intense sortie, Kallen unzips her form-fitting pilot suit at the chest. Sweat glistens on her collarbones under the holographic instrument glow as she gives a fierce, relieved smile.
data.animaCaption: Kallen resting in the Guren cockpit with unzipped pilot suit, sweat glistening on her skin.
